conditions.noise: independent zero-mean Gaussian state measurement noise at 10Hz
conditions.delay: one-sample 0.1s delay of 12 rigid-body feedback states; initial measurement held at startup
conditions.noise_delay: noise at acquisition, then same one-sample delay

actuatorFeedback: current exact actuator states for both methods; no actuator sensor noise or delay
pairing: same acquisition noise array and seed for PID/MPC; noise never injected into physical state
metrics: truth cross-track RMSE after30s, final50s RMSE, actual rudder TV, input bounds, completion, finalQPfailures; paired differences and seed mean/std, no significance claim with n=3
interpretation: assumed sensitivity levels, not specifications of actual DVL/IMU hardware; no estimator or retuning
gates: all runs retained including failures; finite state and original operating domain, amplitude/rate bounds, no finalQPfailure. Do not require MPC to win every run.
